ann_001.title: First Quarter 2026 Batch Orientation
ann_001.message: Orientation for all new JLPT N5 and N4 students begins this Saturday at the main hall. Check your schedule in the portal for your assigned time.

ann_002.title: Payment Portal Reminder
ann_002.message: Please upload your tuition receipts at least three days before the due date. Installment plans are available at the registrar office.

ann_003.title: Japan Culture Day Workshop
ann_003.message: Join the culture day workshop featuring calligraphy, tea ceremony basics, and Nihongo conversation games. Slots are limited to 40 students.

ann_004.title: Mock JLPT Examination Schedule
ann_004.message: Monthly mock examinations for N4 and above will be held on the last Friday of each month. Register through your instructor.

android.releaseNotes: Kanji stroke practice with guided pattern arrows, reading drills, and progress reports.

jlpt_n5.name: JLPT N5 (Beginner)
jlpt_n5.description: Foundation Japanese covering hiragana, katakana, basic kanji, essential grammar, and everyday vocabulary for absolute beginners.

jlpt_n4.name: JLPT N4 (Intermediate)
jlpt_n4.description: Intermediate Japanese with te-form conjugation, plain form grammar, 300 additional kanji, and comprehension of everyday conversations.

jlpt_n3.name: JLPT N3 (Advanced)
jlpt_n3.description: Advanced Japanese bridging intermediate to upper level: complex grammar patterns, newspaper reading, and natural-speed listening.

jlpt_n2.name: JLPT N2 (Expert)
jlpt_n2.description: Expert-level Japanese for work and study in Japan: formal keigo, abstract reading passages, and nuanced listening comprehension.

bundle_n5_n4.name: Bundle N5 and N4 (Beginner to Intermediate)
bundle_n5_n4.description: Continuous six-month track from complete beginner to JLPT N4 level with a single enrollment and unified schedule.

bundle_n5_n3.name: Bundle N5-N3 (Beginner to Advanced)
bundle_n5_n3.description: Fast-track ten-month program carrying dedicated learners from zero foundation to conversational, JLPT N3-level Japanese.
